reviews.author: Jodi Brislin
reviews.text: I'm new to the area and Jimmy was recommended by a neighbor. After about a week, he finally called to say I needed a fuel pump. OK, go ahead and do it. 900+ later I go to get gas and click click click, can't get gas. I take it back, he acknowledged that it was something THEY did and would fix it. He also said he knows it's not my problem. 2 more days in the shop later he charges me another 120 for a mistake THEY made. Now 31 of that was gas that they put in, but I didn't need them to fill my tank. They could've put in 10. Anyway, everything they did is legal, but it's so wrong to charge someone to fix your mistake. Not good people. UPDATE: Just tried to get gas again and it's still not fixed!!! I'm getting a lawyer.

reviews.author: Bette
reviews.text: We were delivering a car to my friend and her son, (our Godson). We knew the inspection was due soon and didn't want any problems when they went to get the tag. Jimmy's got us in quickly and had the inspection done in less than 15 minutes. We are from the Charlotte area and really appreciated the hospitality!

reviews.author: Jose Saucedo
reviews.text: Great mechanics, I got referred by a friend to get one of my tie rod ends to be replaced and get an alignment and two new tires installed for a great price compared to the other shops in the area I will be coming back for any other problems and very respectful and helpful.

reviews.author: Robert Yore
reviews.text: Took my f450 for an alignment and to check the front end. Went to two other in Jacksonville before and neither one could fix it. Jimmy knew right away what the problem was. I was very impressed with the level of technology and knowledge. Price was more than resonable

reviews.author: Melinda Stone
reviews.text: Just called to get a quote on swapping out my alternator and dude said I have no idea and didn't say anything else ... Very rude. Wish I would've caught his name cuz the reviews for this place are great. Hate for one bad apple to spoil the bunch!!

reviews.author: Shanna Dee
reviews.text: Got my inspection done here! They were super friendly and quick to get us in! 5 stars for sure! Jimmy is the awesome!!

reviews.author: Latrice Williams
reviews.text: Had a bad experience! Went to the auto place for an inspection, the man was standing out side and watched us pull up. My husband got out the car and walked basically beside the Man and he ignored him. He stood there waiting and as time passed my husband walked ALL THE WAY to the man and the man basically never turned toward my husband but Rudely told him hold on. Basically brushed him off. I would not recommend goin here.

reviews.author: Sonya
reviews.text: Got a flat tire while driving to Wilmington for a delivery, stopped by Jimmy's Garage to get it fixed. I was out in 30 minutes with a used tire for around $50. Still made my delivery on time! Excellent service.

reviews.author: Lindsay Mertz
reviews.text: Cannot thank Jimmy and his team enough. We got a flat tire on the way home from the beach and they got us in and out with a patch, both super fast and incredibly nice service. Thank you!

reviews.author: Bobbie Eiler
reviews.text: Motorcycle inspection - 1st time there and owner was so nice, didn't need an appt only waited 20 min. Will sure be back but will make an appt.

reviews.author: Dee Williams
reviews.text: Jimmy's Garage has served my family for years. Jimmy and his staff are kind and honest mechanics. Keep up the great work guys.

reviews.author: Jared Barclay
reviews.text: PLEASE DON'T! I have never been ripped off like I was at Jimmy's garage. He charged me $120 for a $20 part and then beat my truck to pieces. He broke my fuel gage, bent my fuel lines completely off, never fixed the issue I had, and with a host of other issues I finally had to pay another mechanic $500 to fix a $200 job that I was charged $300 for. Not to mention they had my truck for a week when it should take one hour to replace a fuel pump on an '88 Ford F150. I am one of many out here in Wallace that has been done wrong by Jimmy. Please don't make the same mistake I did and avoid Jimmy's at all costs. You have been warned..

reviews.author: Laurie Hanchar
reviews.text: Thank you Jimmy for fitting me into your schedule!! Highly recommend! Excellent, timely professional service. I will be using Jimmy's again.

reviews.author: Michael Henderson
reviews.text: Great people and always taken care of you. Been going there for about 10 years and would recommend them over anyone in Wallace!!! Thank you guys for all your hard work and dedication!!!

reviews.author: Dexter McBride
reviews.text: Great customer service friendly not expensive and very great work on vehicle. Highly recommended for anyone on a budget

reviews.author: Jennifer
reviews.text: Always nice friendly service. Never had a problem with this garage. I get all my vehicles inspected here.

reviews.author: Shawn Green
reviews.text: Went for my inspection and was in and out fast. Will return there for my oil change because their price is just as good as a shop in wilmington.

reviews.author: Silvia Santiago
reviews.text: First time at Jimmys garage.. i will definitely be back here again, they are very professional/kind people and quick oil change!!

reviews.author: itsasham90
reviews.text: Great! Did a walk in inspection in 20 minutes. Great, friendly and FAST place. Very knowledgeable as well.

reviews.author: Ray Rosso
reviews.text: I go to Jimmy's for my annual auto inspection. They're very professional, perform a thorough inspection, and are always helpful

reviews.author: Sue Davey
reviews.text: Stopped in for an inspection. Jimmy handled it well and has been in business there for 38 years. The inspection took less than 30 minutes, even without an appointment!

reviews.author: James Reed
reviews.text: I always go there because they are very professional and the service is A+,I recommend them to all my friends and family.
